itens.trecho: Um bom filme animado. Este filme foi dos primeiros a dar protagonismo a uma personagem secundária (mas engraçada) de outro filme de animação. É uma moda dos estúdios de animação que nem sempre foi capaz de nos dar bons filmes mas certamente ajudou a aumentar os seus lucros.

The suave and debonair “Puss” has been hard done by and is determined to clear his name of a scurrilous conviction that has shaken him to his very boots - but that’s no easy task, especially when he manages to get himself embroiled with “Kitty Softpaws” and his erstwhile pal “Humpty” who was responsible for most of his troubles in the first place.
Love puss in boots. It was kind of weird that humpty dumpty was in the movie though. Still very good movie and very funny.
